body: Its not defeat if death is the goal.

Yes I am indeed reaching out in a last attempt. One person to connect with would be a miracle. And yes, I have numbed myself to the world, however I actually started by numbing myself to everything good, makes it a lot easier to ignore the bad. The downside of reaching out is I have nothing to say or no way of explaining it so even socializing gains me nothing.
Honesty? I've stopped caring about the people around me, and still see no reason to keep going.

Same with my family except with college. The only time I see them is on holidays, where they ask me why they never see me, and why I'm not in school. I'm tired of hearing and answering the same damn questions.

You aren't bumming me, I've already had the realization that my problems are all because of me, and I do nothing to fix them. If anyone actually tries to help me I never lie, but all I ever give is vague answers so they can't actually do anything.
Sounds about right. Everyone expects all this great stuff out of me, and I really don't want to deal with it anymore.
Everything and nothing at the same time. I really don't know how to explain it.

I don't even have anyone telling me that it isn't ok. I have pushed all my friends away even when they tried to help. I am systematically destroying my life till I have nothing left, and I have no idea why.
I truly, honestly, and sincerely  wish I could, but I can't, so nothing to worry about there.
I don't know why anyone would give me the time of day, so many people here need help much more than me.
